units.source_text: 就在我要动身的时候（记得是两天前的傍晚），父亲又突然晕倒了。

en.t: Just as I was about to leave, I think it was the evening two days before, my father suddenly collapsed again.

units.source_text: 那时我正在给装满书籍和衣物的行李打捆，父亲在洗澡。

en.t: At the time I was tying up the luggage packed with books and clothes, and my father was taking a bath.

units.source_text: 听到去给父亲搓澡的母亲大声喊我，我跑去一看，光着身子的父亲被母亲从后面抱着。

en.t: When I heard my mother, who had gone to scrub my father's back, calling loudly for me, I ran over and saw my naked father being held from behind by my mother.

units.source_text: 可是回到堂屋后，父亲却说不要紧了。

en.t: But after we returned to the main room, my father said that he was all right now.

units.source_text: 为了慎重起见，我坐在父亲枕边，用湿手巾冰着他的头。

en.t: To be safe, I sat by my father's pillow and cooled his head with a wet towel.

units.source_text: 直到九点多钟，我才凑合吃了点晚饭。

en.t: It was not until after nine o'clock that I finally managed to eat a little supper.

units.source_text: 没想到第二天，父亲的精神好多了。

en.t: Unexpectedly, the next day my father was much more spirited.

units.source_text: 而且还不听劝，自己去上了厕所。

en.t: He even ignored our attempts to stop him and went to the toilet by himself.

units.source_text: “已经不碍事了。”

en.t: "It is no trouble now."

units.source_text: 父亲又重复了一遍去年年底摔倒时对我说过的话。

en.t: My father again repeated the same words he had said to me when he fell at the end of the previous year.

units.source_text: 那时候，的确像他说的那样，暂时不要紧了。

en.t: At that time, just as he had said, he really was all right for the time being.

units.source_text: 我想，这回或许也没事吧。

en.t: I thought that perhaps this time too it might turn out to be nothing serious.

units.source_text: 医生只是叮嘱我们，一定要多加注意，却不把话说清楚。

en.t: The doctor merely warned us that we must be very careful, but he would not explain things clearly.

units.source_text: 我因此心神不定，到了出发的日子，也没有心思去东京了。

en.t: Because of that I felt uneasy, and when the day of departure came, I no longer had the heart to go to Tokyo.

units.source_text: “要不我再待几天，没事了再走吧。”

en.t: "Maybe I should stay a few more days and leave once everything is all right."

units.source_text: 我跟母亲商量。

en.t: I discussed it with my mother.

units.source_text: “最好这样。”

en.t: "That would be best."

units.source_text: 母亲也希望我再待些日子。

en.t: My mother also wanted me to stay a while longer.

units.source_text: 母亲看到父亲有精神去院子或去后院的时候，丝毫不担心，

en.t: When my mother saw that my father had the energy to go out into the garden or around to the back yard, she was not worried at all,

units.source_text: 可是一出现这种情况，她又过分地担忧。

en.t: but as soon as something like this happened, she became excessively anxious again.

units.source_text: “你今天不是去东京吗？”

en.t: "Were you not supposed to go to Tokyo today?"

units.source_text: 父亲问我。

en.t: My father asked me.

units.source_text: “是啊，推迟了几天。”

en.t: "Yes, I have put it off for a few days."

units.source_text: 我答道。

en.t: I answered.

units.source_text: “是为了我吗？”

en.t: "Is it because of me?"

units.source_text: 父亲又问。

en.t: My father asked again.
